title: Move the routes into a table
goal: Adding a route is one entry in one place, and nothing a client sees changes.

acceptance_criteria.text: src/routes.mjs exports routes: an array with one entry { method, path, handler } for each route of the HTTP contract in README.md, with path written as the README writes it (for example /todos/:id). src/server.mjs finds the entry for a request in that array and has no route of its own.
Every request gets the answer it gets today: status, body and headers. That is all of the HTTP contract in README.md, including what is not a route and which methods a route does not have.
The existing tests pass unchanged. Tests are added for the parts of the contract that have none.

context.notes: A refactoring: no new behaviour, and createServer keeps its options. High risk because every route goes through the change. Keep node:http only; no dependencies.
